source_summaries.cdc_codenames: The CDC birth/death file provides detailed information on infant characteristics, maternal health behaviors, and pregnancy outcomes. However, it lacks specific variables related to SUID definitions based on ICD-10 codes, postconceptional age, bed sharing, inner ear dysfunction, neuronal stimulation, chronic intermittent hypoxia exposure, breathing patterns, survival rates, inhibition/excitation measures, lipopolysaccharide administration, progesterone treatment, and neurogenesis. Variables for maternal smoking status, preterm birth, breastfeeding status at discharge, and geographic location are available but may require recoding or derivation.
